hints.title: Inspect Output Pattern by String Length
hints.text: The number of encoded strings of length L is 2^L, matching numbers ordered within binary representations.

hints.title: Add 1 to the Input Number
hints.text: Notice that num + 1 in binary begins with 1 followed exactly by the desired encoded bitstring.

hints.title: Strip Leading Bit
hints.text: Convert num + 1 to binary string format and slice away the leading 1 bit.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Enumerating binary strings of increasing lengths takes proportional time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Binary representation of num + 1 gives the exact answer directly in logarithmic time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should notice the 1-to-1 correspondence between num + 1 binary representation and the encoding.
complexity.notes: When num is 0, num + 1 is 1, which after stripping leading 1 leaves the empty string.
